column1: # One verdict per published Gmail API method. Held by `go run ./scripts/gates api-coverage`.
# Columns: method id, state, phase, verdict. The verb and path live in testdata/api-surface.json.
# used: a client call exists (internal/gapi). planned: judged used or gated, built in the named phase.
# out: deferred or written off; the verdict says why.

column4: Used: `create_draft`, including replies and forwards; a multipart upload above 5 MB. Never repeated after an ambiguous failure
Used: `delete_draft`, with `confirm: true` and the draft's `message_id` as a witness. Permanent, but only ever an unsent draft, so it is a default write rather than one behind the destructive flag
Used: `get_draft`, and the witness read before `update_draft`
Used: `list_drafts`
Gated: `send_draft`, registered only with `GMAIL_ENABLE_SEND=true`, behind the recipient guard; never retried; an ambiguous outcome is settled by reading
Used: `update_draft`. A PUT of the whole draft with no ETag, so the id of the message inside it, which every update changes, is the witness; a multipart upload above 5 MB
